d:
India’s men’s kabaddi team are the Commonwealth Kabaddi Champions, capping off an unbeaten campaign with a commanding 54-20 victory over Sri Lanka in the final in Ahmedabad, Gujarat!
India dominated the title clash, with Aditya Shinde delivering a SUPER 10 and Yogesh registering a HIGH 5 to lead the charge. From start to finish, the Indian team showcased outstanding raiding, rock-solid defence and true championship spirit to lift the trophy without losing a match!
